text: As I stand in this bright and open corridor, looking through a glass wall into a meeting or exhibition room, I am struck by the interplay of transparency and reflection. The space feels modern, curated, and perhaps a little clinical. There’s a sense of anticipation, as if ideas are ready to be exchanged just beyond the glass. I feel alert, curious about what kind of knowledge or creativity might be fostered here, and vaguely aware of my own presence in this reflective, almost liminal boundary between outside and inside.
